ma.createBLEConnection(Object object)

Connect Bluetooth Low Energy devices (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
deviceId String Yes Bluetooth device id
timeout number 30000 No Connection timeout in ms. If left blank, the default timeout is 30 seconds.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String createBLEConnection: ok

object.fail Callback Function

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String error message

Sample Code

ma.createBLEConnection({
  deviceId: 'deviceId',
  success: (res) => {
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'createBLEConnection success',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
  },
  fail: (res) => {
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'createBLEConnection fail',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
  }
})

Tips

If already searched for a Bluetooth device and successfully established a connection, it can directly pass the deviceId obtained from the previous search to directly attempt to connect to the device without searching again. If the Bluetooth adapter module is disabled on the iOS device, the interface for connecting to the Bluetooth low energy device must be called again after the Bluetooth device is found by calling ma.startBluetoothDevicesDiscovery api.
